overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in the leading '*' discriminator (object name vs. Variable/Field); collapsed into one overload sharing the (already-correct) function-result return type.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: refMode
params.description: Mode for handling references found in the text

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Strips all style tags from the designated styled-text object and returns the resulting plain text, optionally controlling how embedded expression/URL references are rendered via refMode.
